reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPEN EXTEND of a report file must position the file immediately after the last logical record written in it, so the report lines a later INITIATE/GENERATE/TERMINATE produce follow every record already there (an empty file: from its start; an absent OPTIONAL file: created per GR1 Table 1; an absent non-optional file: the OPEN is unsuccessful).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002): at 85 the implementor default sharing is AllOther (no Table 19), from 2002 NoOther for an EXTEND
FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect: at 85 no Table 19 arbitration and sibling connectors release buffered records before the OPEN; from 2002 Table 19 arbitrates

the posture-derived HostShare, which selects the writer stream kind (a repositioning append stream when another writer is admitted, plain FileMode.Append otherwise); both append at the end of the medium

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in SequentialConnector.cs, FileConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs; the EXTEND arm of SequentialConnector.OpenCore itself consults no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the sharing posture differs (85 AllOther, 2023 NoOther) but the EXTEND position is the end of the medium in both; ext1.cob prints identical output at --std 85 and --std 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_z02 covers one OUTPUT then one EXTEND of a nonempty unpaged file; repeated EXTEND, a paged file ending after a page feed, an empty existing file, an absent OPTIONAL file and an absent non-optional file were probed here

probes.printed: EXTEND R STATUS 00 / EXTEND O (EMPTY) STATUS 00 / EXTEND M (ABSENT) STATUS 35 / AFTER FAILED OPEN / EXT1R: A1 A2 A3 <FF> A4 B1 C1 C2 (od: 'A3 FF A4 CR LF B1 CR LF C1 CR LF C2 CR LF') / EXT1O: O1 / OPEN INPUT EXT1M STATUS 35
probes.expected: each EXTEND appends after the last record written (B1 after A4, C1 C2 after B1); an empty existing file takes O1 as its first record; an absent non-optional file: OPEN unsuccessful (35), the INITIATE/GENERATE after it produce nothing and no file is created

probes.printed: EXTEND O (EMPTY) STATUS 05 ... report file EXT2O read back: REC 01 [O1]
probes.expected: an absent OPTIONAL file opened EXTEND is created (Table 1) and the report line is its first record

probes.printed: error COBOL1803: OPEN EXTEND 'RPT-FILE' WITH NO REWIND - the phrase may be specified only when the INPUT or OUTPUT phrase is specified
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format gives NO REWIND to the OUTPUT phrase only
same positioning at the latest edition

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR10  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10
OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR1  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: A report file is a sequential file; its EXTEND arm opens the writer with FileMode.Append (CreateNew for an absent OPTIONAL file) after the 35 check for an absent non-optional file. The seed sites in IndexedConnector/KeyedConnector are not on a report file's path. Variable-length (class a) and numeric (class f) probe classes do not apply to this positioning rule.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-204/ex1.cob at --std 85 (runs/ex1-002): OPEN OUTPUT of two report files in one statement, then OPEN EXTEND R1-FILE R2-FILE (GR17 multi-file form) status 00 00, a re-INITIATE in the other order, then a third OPEN EXTEND of one file. The paged file (PAGE LIMIT 6, PF at line 5) reads back as the first report's lines 1-5 followed immediately by the second report's lines (no padding of the unwritten page bottom, no extra form feed), and the unpaged file reads B1 B2 B3 contiguous: each EXTEND writes immediately after the last record written. Grepped SequentialConnector/FileConnector/FileRegistry/CobolFile for Edition/DialectBehavior: only the sharing posture sites the reader listed. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR10 'positions the file immediately after the last logical record for that file'; OK §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR17 'the same as if a separate OPEN statement had been written for each file-name'.
